title: Dalisay Upo (Dalisay F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Dalisay upo is an F1 hybrid upo variety from East West Seed. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Dalisay upo is an F1 hybrid upo variety, also sold or known as Dalisay F1 or Upo Dalisay F1. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from East West Seed.

heroImage.alt: Ampalaya seedlings planted through plastic mulch on raised beds, the kind of farm where Dalisay upo is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Dalisay F1 or Upo Dalisay F1, this is the same upo. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [upo variety finder](/crop-varieties/upo), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for gourds and melons](/land-preparation/cucurbit-land-preparation).

rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: about 65 days to maturity. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit upo fields most often: [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [melon fly](/pests/melon-fly), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [squash beetle](/pests/squash-beetle). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: first in the upo variety table and sold under East West's name in online agri stores (Agrify). Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Dalisay upo

Upo grows fast on a trellis. Pick a variety with a smooth, even fruit that stays tender, and harvest it young. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Dalisay F1 the same as Dalisay?
items.a: Yes. Dalisay F1 is another name for Dalisay. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Dalisay?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
